Use case: identity-preserve character pose edit.
Edit the supplied canonical portrait of THE KEEPER into the ATTACK pose for a painted 2D game sprite. ONE full-body character, ONE pose, 1024x1536 portrait, real transparent RGBA background.

Identity and wardrobe must match exactly: the tall, very slender railway keeper with an antique round brass CLOCK FOR A HEAD, aged ivory dial with correctly oriented Roman numerals and clock hands, expressive stern eyes integrated into the dial, no human head or hair; weathered plum/burgundy railway coat with gold edging, brass buttons and station badge; matching peaked railway cap; dark waistcoat and necktie over ivory shirt; dark striped trousers, long black gloves, worn buckle shoes. Preserve readable clock face orientation and the source's particular asymmetric head/cap design. Do not mirror, replace or melt the Roman numerals. Keep all costume pieces intact, pocket-chain and brass details recognizable. Same hand-painted gouache fabric, fine ink contours, subdued plum and brass palette, neutral warm lighting.

ATTACK POSE: facing and striking toward SCREEN LEFT, a crisp, stern, almost mechanical straight punch with one long black-gloved arm extended firmly toward an unseen opponent at shoulder height; the opposite gloved hand held close to the chest. Weight shifts onto the forward left foot, rear foot braces, torso leans forward only slightly, coat skirts swing back toward the right. The clock head turns toward the target with narrowed stern eyes; cap stays on. The gesture is precise and authoritative, not wild or acrobatic. Preserve the unusual tall narrow silhouette and believable articulated limbs. Both hands EMPTY. No baton, weapon, magic, clock fragments, projected clock face or extra objects.

FRAMING: same camera and approximately the same full-body scale as source. Body centered, entire attacking glove, cap, clock rim, coat tails and both shoes visible with 5% transparent safe margin. Soles near95% canvas height. Only ONE clock-headed body with two arms and two legs. Clean transparent alpha throughout background and between limbs; remove the original dark vignette/glow completely. No floor, cast shadow, scenery, speed streaks, impact symbols, opponent, lettering, labels, frame or watermark. Change pose and expression only, preserving the original character design.

Match source eye-level camera and overall figure size. Body remains near the canvas center, supporting foot at roughly95% height; the entire hat, clock rim, hands, flying coat, and BOTH shoes remain visible with 5% transparent breathing room. Real alpha around all edges and in limb gaps, no retained vignette or glow. No floor, ground shadow, scene, opponent, blood, particles, lightning, impact star, motion lines, extra objects, text, borders or watermark.

His torso leans into the motion, front left boot plants, back boot braces. Eyes focus determinedly toward the left, mouth tense but not snarling. Wings lift and flare a LITTLE behind him to suggest effort and balance; antennae sweep gently backward toward the right. The clear attack gesture comes from the hand and forward weight, not from a magical effect. Empty hands, no lamp, bell, weapon, projectile or opponent.

Keep the gesture compact and the wings partly folded so ALL anatomy fits: entire two antennae, both hands, every wingtip, satchel, both full boots. Maintain the original full-body camera, body scale and costume; center torso, soles around95% canvas height, reserve at least5% clear margin at all sides. Exactly two humanlike arms and two legs, no additional insect limbs. Truly transparent background and gaps between silhouette parts, clean antialiased alpha. Remove original vignette/glow. No floor, cast shadow, scenery, pollen, sparks, dust, speed streaks, impact star, blood, text, frame or watermark.
